name: Leichlingen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Leichlingen (a red lion on white above a fish on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Leichlingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
